features.name: Generate One
features.description: Creates one identifier with the library default configuration.

features.name: Generate Batch
features.description: Fills a preallocated array of 1,024 identifiers.

features.name: Format
features.description: Converts a pre-generated identifier into its canonical text.

features.name: Parse
features.description: Reconstructs an identifier from its canonical representation.

features.name: Extract Timestamp
features.description: Reads the creation time embedded in a pre-generated identifier.

features.name: Encode Numbers
features.description: Maps a fixed number sequence to a short string.

features.name: Decode Numbers
features.description: Maps a string back to the number sequence that produced it.

features.name: Sortable Order
features.description: Compares adjacent identifiers generated at increasing timestamps to prove ordinal order follows time.
